subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should structured agent-facing usage live as optional `session_status` details or as a separate usage tool, and which cost, quota, visibility, and freshness guarantees form the supported contract?
rationale: Both boundaries are technically feasible, but choosing the permanent model-facing API, payload size, privacy rules, and provider-specific semantics requires product ownership rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Extend status details
options.body: Add an optional bounded `usage` object to `session_status.details`, backed by existing aggregators and explicit availability, source, and freshness fields.

options.title: Create a usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` lightweight and introduce a dedicated agent-facing usage query with session and last-turn modes.

options.title: Keep display-only behavior
options.body: Retain status cards and operator gateway RPCs without creating a supported agent-facing raw-usage contract.

recommendation.title: Extend status details
recommendation.body: Add an optional bounded `usage` object to `session_status.details`, backed by existing aggregators and explicit availability, source, and freshness fields.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the broadest recent history across the tool, rendering, docs, gateway aggregation, and prior product-review discussion.
